# U.S. News Cars

> U.S. News Cars is a comprehensive automotive marketplace and pricing platform offering new and used vehicle shopping, inventory search, and price comparison tools.

The site provides consumers with access to detailed vehicle listings, pricing information, and shopping tools across multiple vehicle types and locations. It leverages partnerships with data providers like Experian AutoCheck and TrueCar to deliver transparent pricing and vehicle history information.

## Key Topics

- Best Price Program
- Used Car Marketplace
- Price Comparison
- Vehicle Inventory Search
- Electric Vehicles (EVs)
- SUV Listings
- Certified Pre-Owned
- Car Pricing
- Dealership Pricing
- New Car Shopping
- AutoCheck
- San Jose, CA
- Buying Guide
- Price Filters
- Vehicle Search

## Best Price Program & Shopping

- [U.S. News Best Price Program](https://bestprice.cars.usnews.com/): U.S. News Best Price Program homepage for car shopping and price comparison

## Used Vehicle Marketplace

- [Used SUVs for Sale in San Jose, CA (with Photos)](https://bestprice.cars.usnews.com/used-cars-for-sale/listings/body-suv/): Used SUV marketplace for San Jose, CA with pricing and inventory search
- [Used Electric Cars for Sale in San Jose, CA (with Photos)](https://bestprice.cars.usnews.com/used-cars-for-sale/listings/fuel-electric/): Used electric vehicle marketplace for San Jose, CA with Tesla and EV listings
